title: RTT Resonance Truth Anchor
description: Schema for a bounded reference Anchor used by the RTT Resonance Truth Service v0.1 model. An Anchor identifies a recognized reference within a declared domain and operational regime. Anchor authority is bounded and does not imply universal correctness.

anchor_type.description: Domain-specific classification of the Anchor, such as temporal_reference, trust_anchor, namespace_authority, or another bounded reference type.

authority.description: Human-readable description of the authority or reference relationship represented by this Anchor. This field does not imply universal or context-free authority.

domain.description: Operational domain within which the Anchor is meaningful.

regime_ids.description: Identifiers of operational Regimes that explicitly recognize or use this Anchor.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the Anchor.

valid_from.description: Beginning of the Anchor's known validity interval, when applicable.

valid_until.description: End of the Anchor's known validity interval, when applicable. Null indicates no known explicit end.

revocation_reference.description: Optional reference identifying revocation, withdrawal, replacement, or related lifecycle information.

limitations.description: Explicit limitations on the scope or interpretation of this Anchor.

created_at.description: Timestamp at which the Anchor record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent Anchor-record update.

metadata.description: Optional domain-specific or implementation metadata. Metadata must not override canonical Anchor fields.

then.description: A revoked Anchor may remain historically referenceable. Revocation changes current qualification and does not erase prior evaluations.
